MOVEIT_GRAPH.finding: MoveIt does not load the description the robot boots with. Bringup loads src/M3Pro/urdf/m3pro.urdf (cb0923106366) from workspace M3Pro_ws; MoveIt loads src/yahboom_M3Pro_description/urdf/M3Pro.urdf (5a96608cf2c6) from workspace yahboomcar_ws. Two descriptions of one robot, in two workspaces, differing in content

ARM_KINEMATIC_CHAIN.not_physical_calibration: these are the numbers the vendor's description contains. None has been compared against the robot

CAMERA_GRAPH.frame_note: only the mechanical mount link exists in the description. The RGB, depth and optical frames are published by the driver at runtime, so they are NOT_REPRESENTED_IN_SOURCE rather than identity transforms. Treating an absent frame as a zero transform is how an uncalibrated optical offset becomes invisible

ORBBEC_CONFIGURATION.driver_source_finding: the workspace contains an OrbbecSDK_ROS2 directory that ships zero files, and no package declaring orbbec_camera exists in either workspace. The camera is fully configured and its driver source is not in the vendor archive
ORBBEC_CONFIGURATION.CONFIGURED_TOPICS_NOTE: the launch file sets a namespace and the driver names the topics. Topic names are therefore a property of the driver source, which is absent, so no CONFIGURED_TOPIC is recorded rather than a plausible one being written down
ORBBEC_CONFIGURATION.intrinsics_source: no calibration URL is configured, so intrinsics come from the device's own factory calibration at runtime. Nothing in the source pins them

NEGATIVE_SPACE.frames_detail: laser0_frame and laser1_frame are published as static transforms from base_link at launch and are not links in m3pro.urdf, so the description alone does not describe where the ranging sensors are
NEGATIVE_SPACE.drivers_detail: no node in either workspace is configured to publish the two input scans the merger consumes. The consumer, the merge parameters and the frames are all present; the drivers are not

TOF_CONFIGURATION.COVERAGE_NOTE: the merge is configured over a full turn, which is a configured angular span and not a measurement of what the two sensors can see. Coverage is a runtime and geometric question this tranche does not answer

CLAIM_BOUNDARY: every sensor value here is configured, not observed. Nothing was launched, no topic was subscribed, and no transform was compared against the robot
